headline: Clean Science and Technology: SEBI Reg 31(4) Substantial Acquisition Disclosure
sum: Clean Science and Technology Limited filed a mandatory SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure announcing a substantial acquisition of shares crossing the 5% threshold, triggering takeover code compliance.
detail: Clean Science and Technology Limited submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE, a mandatory filing when any person acquires 5% or more of a listed company's shares. The disclosure format requires identification of the acquirer, shareholding pattern pre- and post-acquisition, and timing of compliance. The filing indicates a material change in control or influence over the company, subject to SEBI Takeover Regulations enforcement and potential open offer triggers unless exempted.
